article_title: Analysis of Student Behaviour in Habitable Worlds Using Continuous Representation Visualization
citation: Pardos, Z. A., & Horodyskyj, L. (2018). Analysis of Student Behaviour in Habitable Worlds Using Continuous Representation Visualization. https://github.com/CAHLR/d3-scatterplot
title: d3-scatterplot open-source visualization tool
description: An interactive, in-house d3-based visualization developed alongside the research to let the subject matter expert inspect plots by hovering over points to reveal semantic meta-information such as the question name and lesson, with a colouring feature for categorical attributes like lesson. The article notes its features were similar to the commercial package Tableau but that it "is now open sourced to the community," with the benefit of being easily linked via URL in shared web documents. It served as the inspection interface for the skip-gram/t-SNE visualizations in the Habitable Worlds case study.
requirements: A browser-based d3 environment; the tool is hosted and shared via URL links in web documents
target_learners: online higher education students (whose data the tool visualizes)
target_learning_goals: instructor analysis of student behaviour to improve course design
examples: Used by the course instructor to inspect the highest-rated visualization with annotations, hovering over plot points to reveal element metadata
key_sources: Pardos, Z. A., & Horodyskyj, L. (2018). Analysis of Student Behaviour in Habitable Worlds Using Continuous Representation Visualization. https://github.com/CAHLR/d3-scatterplot

article_title: Are we on the same learning curve: Visualization of Semantic Similarity of Course Objectives
citation: Atish Pawar, Sahib Budhiraja, Daniel Kivi, Vijay Mago. (2018). Are we on the same learning curve: Visualization of Semantic Similarity of Course Objectives. arXiv preprint. https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.06339
title: d3-based web visualization of semantic similarity between LO keywords (bubbles, relationships, Venn overlap)
description: A web interface built with the d3 javascript library that visualizes semantic similarity between keywords of two LO sentences in three parts: a) keyword clouds as d3-physics bubbles whose radius scales with the computed similarity index, b) one-to-one or one-to-many relationship links between words of the two clouds, and c) Venn diagrams whose bubble overlap conveys similarity. It is intended to assist domain experts and project managers comparing courses for transfer agreements.
requirements: The similarity indexes computed by the word similarity methodology must be available to drive bubble radius and connections.
target_learners: program managers preparing transfer program agreements
target_learning_goals: comparing and matching learning outcomes of two courses for credit transfer
examples: The tool was used to visualize keyword clouds, one-to-one and many-to-one relationships, and Venn overlap for two example programming-related LO statements.
key_sources: Atish Pawar, Sahib Budhiraja, Daniel Kivi, Vijay Mago. (2018). Are we on the same learning curve: Visualization of Semantic Similarity of Course Objectives. arXiv preprint. https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.06339
